title: Low-dose cyclophosphamide maintenance after neoadjuvant systemic chemotherapy and surgery to eradicate microscopic residual disease in PDAC
official: Low-dose cyclophosphamide maintenance after neoadjuvant systemic chemotherapy and surgery to eradicate microscopic residual disease in PDAC
summary: Main objective: To compare the DFS of patients treated with CTX (Arm A) vs untreated (Arm B)
conditions: Pathological diagnosis of PDAC, Previous radical (R0 or R1) surgical resection and NAT with PAXG regimen (4-6 months)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Written informed consent
2. Adequate liver function: ALT and AST < 3 ULN; Serum total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 ULN
3. Patients of any gender, race and ethnicity aged ≥18 years;
4. Pathological diagnosis of PDAC
5. Previous radical (R0 or R1) surgical resection
6. NAT with PAXG regimen (4-6 months)
7. Patient’s willingness to undergo blood draws to provide plasma and blood samples for  analysis according to study objectives
8. ECOG performance status of 2 or less
9. Adequate bone marrow function (GB ≥ 3500/mm3, neutrophils ≥1500/mm3, platelets ≥  100000/mm3, Hb ≥10 g/dl)
10. Adequate kidney function (serum creatinine < 1.5 mg/dL)
Exclusion criteria:
1. Pregnancy or lactation; males or female of childbearing potential not employing adequate  contraceptive methods cannot be included
2. Any condition including the presence of laboratory abnormalities, which places the subject  at unacceptable risk if he/she were to participate in the study
3. Any condition that confounds the ability to interpret data from the study
4. Any familiar, sociologic or geographic conditions that can potentially interfere with the  adhesion to the protocol or to the follow-up
5. Inflammatory disease of the colon or rectum, or occlusion or sub-occlusion of the intestine
6. Concurrent treatment with other experimental drugs
7. Lactose intolerance: only for site that are not able to prepare a galenic formulation that  can be used in substitution to commercial cyclophosphamide
8. Other types of non-ductal tumor of the pancreas, including endocrine tumors or acinar cell  carcinoma, cystadenocarcinoma and other periampullary malignancies
9. Prior (within 1 year) or concurrent malignancies at other sites with the exception of  surgically cured carcinoma in-situ of the cervix and basal or squamous cell carcinoma of  the skin
10. Active, uncontrolled bacterial, viral, or fungal infection(s) requiring systemic therapy,  defined as ongoing signs/symptoms related to the infection without improvement despite  appropriate antibiotics, antiviral therapy, and/or other treatment
11. Subject receiving immunosuppressive or myelosuppressive medications that would in the  opinion of the investigator, increase the risk of serious neutropenic complications
12. Evidence of disease at any site
13. Tumor marker increase
14. Serious medical risk factors involving any of the major organ systems, or serious  psychiatric disorders, which could compromise the subject's safety or the study data  integrity
15. Any significant medical condition, laboratory abnormality, or psychiatric illness that would  prevent the subject from participating in the study
